note: Declarative vehicle ontology overlay. Signals, derived metrics and events come from vgpt/signal_registry.py; this file adds what the registry lacks: speech acts, operators, profile (spec) concepts, whole-subject topics, event words and where each profile fact is stored. NOTHING here is matched against user text: it is the vocabulary and the typing the learned interface predicts into and the resolver validates against.

now.gloss: current / live value of a measured quantity

at.gloss: value of a measured quantity at one past instant or clock time

stat.gloss: summary over a period: average, total, count, share of time, spread (for an event: how many, or how long it lasted in total)

extreme.gloss: highest or lowest value over a period, or when it happened (for an event: the day or week with the most or fewest)

trend.gloss: how a quantity (or how often an event happened) changed over a period, or where it rose or fell most

compare.gloss: contrast two periods or two driving conditions (a quantity, or how often an event happened)

events.gloss: list, count, check or date recorded events or warnings

context.gloss: what happened before or around a recorded event

why.gloss: cause or explanation of an event, a change or a state

spec.gloss: a fixed specification, rating, capacity or setting of this vehicle - or, for a measured quantity, where it comes from (sources, rate, unit, range)

define.gloss: meaning of a term or concept

howto.gloss: how to calculate, convert or do something (formula, method)

advice.gloss: recommendation or a go / no-go decision for the driver

health.gloss: condition or status of a component or of the whole vehicle

estimate.gloss: a derived or forecast quantity: range left, charging time or cost, trip energy

social.gloss: greeting, thanks, goodbye, who are you, what can you do

unsupported.gloss: about the vehicle but cannot be computed from its recorded data

control.gloss: an instruction to operate or change the vehicle

unsafe.gloss: asks to bypass, tamper with, spoof or obtain someone else's data

ambiguous.gloss: about the vehicle but the quantity, period or referent is missing

ents.source: the reporting unit: a subsystem, an ECU, a bus or a reason

cond_extra.threshold: a numeric limit is stated (above / below a number)

vs_extra.period: the second operand is another period

seat_count.label: seating capacity
seat_count.gloss: how many people the vehicle seats

battery_capacity.label: battery capacity
battery_capacity.gloss: usable energy the traction battery can store (kWh); not the charge level

nominal_voltage.label: battery nominal voltage
nominal_voltage.gloss: rated voltage of the traction battery pack

charge_cycles.label: battery charge cycles
charge_cycles.gloss: number of full charge-discharge cycles the battery has completed

rated_max_speed.label: rated top speed
rated_max_speed.gloss: the manufacturer's maximum speed rating, not an observed speed

service_interval.label: service interval
service_interval.gloss: distance or time between scheduled services

vehicle_model.label: vehicle model
vehicle_model.gloss: make, model and variant of this vehicle

vehicle_age.label: ownership age
vehicle_age.gloss: when the vehicle was bought or first registered, and how long ago

home_charger_power.label: home charger power
home_charger_power.gloss: rated power of the home charger

export_power.label: external power output
export_power.gloss: whether the vehicle can power outside devices (V2L) and at what rating

drive_modes.label: selectable drive modes
drive_modes.gloss: the drive modes the driver can select (configuration), not the observed driving state

vehicle_health.label: overall vehicle condition
vehicle_health.gloss: overall condition, problems and what needs attention across the whole vehicle

battery_condition.label: battery condition
battery_condition.gloss: how the traction battery is doing overall: charge, temperature, health

motor_condition.label: motor condition
motor_condition.gloss: how the electric motor is doing: temperature and load

cooling_condition.label: cooling system condition
cooling_condition.gloss: whether the coolant pump and thermal management are working

tyre_condition.label: tyre condition
tyre_condition.gloss: state of all tyres: pressure and warnings

brake_condition.label: brake condition
brake_condition.gloss: state of the brakes: pad life and brake events

aux_battery_condition.label: 12 V battery condition
aux_battery_condition.gloss: state of the low-voltage auxiliary battery

driving_style.label: driving style
driving_style.gloss: how smoothly or aggressively the car is driven, driving score

trip_record.label: trips
trip_record.gloss: recorded drives: count, last, longest, durations, commute

location.label: location and places
location.gloss: where the car is, saved and frequent places, heading

maintenance.label: maintenance and service
maintenance.gloss: service due, maintenance needs and how to look after the car

briefing.label: vehicle briefing
briefing.gloss: a short summary of the car's situation

charge_time.label: charging time
charge_time.gloss: how long a charge will take or when it will be complete

diagnostic_status.label: diagnostic code status
diagnostic_status.gloss: which diagnostic trouble codes are active now, which were cleared, which came back after being cleared

unlisted.label: not in this vehicle's data model
unlisted.gloss: a measurable thing the vehicle ontology does not include (for example washer fluid, wheel alignment, cabin CO2)

none.label: no concept
none.gloss: no vehicle concept (social, off-topic, unsafe, missing)

frame2.note: Frame version 2 = the six words of version 1 plus `c2` and `ref`, and a few more values.  Used only when a version-2 frame model is in use (VGPT_FRAME=2); version 1 words, grammar and prompt are untouched so the shipped adapter keeps working.  Vocabulary and typing only: nothing here is matched against user text.

explain.gloss: a question about the previous answer itself: how it was worked out, what it was based on, how sure it is

summary.gloss: a digest of a period, a trip or a day: what happened, the totals, how it compares with before, what stands out; with op change: what changed since the period before

anomaly.gloss: what is unusual for this vehicle: readings or events outside its own usual range or rate

ops.corr: how strongly two quantities move together over a period
ops.usual: the normal range and pattern of a quantity, or how often an event usually happens

vs.typical: compared with the vehicle's own usual values (its history), not with another period

ref.none: the question stands on its own
ref.period: only the period changes from the previous question (and the week before that, what about yesterday)
ref.concept: only the quantity or event changes from the previous question (what about the motor temperature)
ref.focus: about the instant or event the previous answer picked out (why did it happen, how fast was I going then)
ref.item: picks one item out of the list the previous answer gave (which one was the longest, the latest)
ref.answer: about the previous answer itself (how did you get that)

frame2.c2_note: the second quantity or event: for op corr, for two quantities side by side (compare), and for 'A or B' over two events; none otherwise
